records.title: The 4/δ Bound: Designing Predictable LLM-Verifier Systems for Formal Method Guarantee
records.reason: A convergence theorem gives termination guarantees for multi-stage LLM-verifier formal verification pipelines; the subject is verification workflow reliability, not inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Operating Conversational Large Language Models (LLMs)in the Presenceof Errors
records.reason: Error injection into Mistral-7B measures how hardware faults degrade MMLU accuracy for conversational LLM dependability; relevant to inference reliability under faults, but it is an evaluation study without a mitigation or serving mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Enhanced Transformer Architecture for Natural Language Processing
records.reason: A modified transformer with full layer normalization, weighted residuals and RL-based positional encoding is proposed for general NLP accuracy; an architecture variant without an inference efficiency or serving focus.

records.title: LargePiG: Your Large Language Model is Secretly a Pointer Generator
records.reason: LargePiG separates content from form in LLM-generated search queries to reduce relevance and factuality hallucinations; a query-generation quality method with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: How can representation dimension dominate structurally pruned LLMs?
records.reason: This analysis shows representation dimension dominates the behavior of structurally pruned LLMs through the linear maps in transformer blocks; pruning insight that informs compression, but no deployable inference mechanism is proposed, so borderline.

records.title: ASDFormer: A Transformer with Mixtures of Pooling-Classifier Experts for Robust Autism Diagnosis and Biomarker Discovery
records.reason: ASDFormer mixes pooling-classifier experts over fMRI connectivity to diagnose autism and find biomarkers; a clinical neuroimaging application with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Activity-Based Costing Framework for Total Cost of Ownership Analysis of LLM Services
records.reason: An activity-based costing framework builds a total-cost-of-ownership model for LLM services, separating infrastructure and organizational cost pools; a financial accounting model for services rather than a technical inference system, so borderline.

records.title: Beyond Transformers: Dendritic State-Space Models
records.reason: Dendritic state-space models add nonlinear dendritic computation to linear-time SSM sequence modeling for vision and language; a generic efficient-architecture proposal without LLM inference evaluation or serving content, hence borderline.

records.title: Analysis on the number of layers in the transformer-based model for neural machine translation
records.reason: Layer counts in transformer encoder-decoders are empirically varied for neural machine translation quality; an architecture sizing study for an MT application with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Scaling transformers to high-dimensional sparse data: a Reformer-BERT approach for large-scale classification
records.reason: A Reformer-BERT hybrid is pretrained for automated cell-type classification from high-dimensional single-cell RNA sequencing data; a bioinformatics application with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Chip-Tuning: Classify Before Language Models Say
records.reason: Chip-tuning probes LLM layers with classifiers to identify and prune redundant layers with marginal quality loss, directly reducing LLM inference cost; a concrete layer-pruning contribution for inference.

records.title: KiC: Keyword-inspired Cascade for Cost-Efficient Text Generation with LLMs
records.reason: KiC cascades cheaper and stronger LLMs using keyword-inspired representative selection to cut API inference cost for text generation; a cascade routing method whose reliability heuristic is application-level, so borderline rather than a serving-system accept.

records.title: Play by the Type Rules: Inferring Constraints for LLM Functions in Declarative Programs
records.reason: Type-rule constraint inference makes LLM operators inside declarative query programs produce outputs aligned with type checkers and database contents; a data-systems integration for correctness of LLM calls, adjacent to inference infrastructure but not efficiency or serving, so borderline.

records.title: Invisible Hands: Gray-Box Bit Flip Attack for Steering LLMs Without Knowledge of Gradients, Data, and Weights
records.reason: A gray-box bit flip attack steers LLM behavior by corrupting parameters without gradient, data or weight knowledge; a hardware-fault security attack study, not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations
records.reason: HyperMem organizes conversational agent memory as a hierarchical hypergraph to capture high-order associations that pairwise RAG retrieval misses; agent memory architecture that affects retrieval at inference, but the contribution is memory representation quality, so borderline.

records.title: Mid-Think: Training-Free Intermediate-Budget Reasoning via Token-Level Triggers
records.reason: Mid-Think uses trigger tokens such as a leading 'Okay' to switch hybrid reasoning models into intermediate thinking budgets without training; a prompting-level control of reasoning length with an inference-cost effect, but no decoding or serving mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: Oblivion: Self-Adaptive Agentic Memory Control through Decay-Driven Activation
records.reason: Oblivion applies decay-driven activation to agent memory read and write paths, reducing interference and retrieval latency as histories grow; an agent memory control framework whose systems benefit is secondary to memory behavior, so borderline.

records.title: AtlasVA: Self-Evolving Visual Skill Memory for Teacher-Free VLM Agents
records.reason: AtlasVA stores visual skill memory for teacher-free VLM agents instead of lossy text summaries; a memory representation for spatial agent tasks, with no LLM serving or decoding mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: MINTEval: Evaluating Memory under Multi-Target Interference in Long-Horizon Agent Systems
records.reason: MINTEval benchmarks memory-augmented agents under multi-target interference over long horizons; an evaluation of agent memory behavior with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: A-TMA: Decoupling State-Aware Memory Failures in Long-Term Agent Memory
records.reason: A-TMA decomposes ghost-memory failures across bank maintenance, retrieval and answer-time resolution in long-term agent memory; a memory-system analysis and overlay for correctness of state, not inference efficiency, so borderline.
